I'm launching jambuild: fast multiplayer vibecoding powered by voice I've been searching for a truly magical multiplayer agent experience. I recently realized, in thinking about it, that multiplayer agentic coding is no fun if you have to wait for the agent, so I made an ultra-fast voice-driven harness. I'm trying to recreate the flow of jamming with someone on Figma or on a whiteboard, but have the medium be code. It uses Deepgram and Pipecat and a small model I trained to do pre-emptive turn detection, and non-thinking coding models with some speed optimizations.
